premium.basis: Approximate premium over the August 14, 2020 closing price of $96.92, as noted in the dossier's buyout rumors section. The dossier also notes a ~75% premium over the share price before the July 2020 Bloomberg rumors.

value_inflection_events.event: Sanofi announces positive Phase 2b data for PRN2246/SAR442168 in relapsing MS
Sanofi announces additional positive Phase 2b data confirming primary and secondary endpoints
Sanofi's unsolicited asset-acquisition proposal of ~$1.5B and escalation to full company acquisition discussion
Sanofi provides revised $82.50 per share offer; Board negotiates value range of $82.50–$100.00
Merger Agreement signed; Sanofi announces $100.00 per share offer
Week of Merger Agreement execution and tender offer filing; stock consolidates near offer price
Merger closes; Principia becomes wholly owned subsidiary of Sanofi

leaked_early.details: Bloomberg reported on July 16, 2020, that Sanofi was studying a potential acquisition of Principia, approximately one month before the official announcement on August 16, 2020.

notes: The deal was driven by Sanofi's desire to fully own the CNS-penetrating BTK inhibitor PRN2246/SAR442168 after positive Phase 2b data, escalating from an unsolicited $1.5B asset purchase to a $3.33B full company acquisition following board rejection and a limited negotiation process constrained by existing license field-of-use restrictions.
